answer: An agent economy can resist sybils with a stake-and-reputation registry that works like an atlas of proven work. Each agent posts a bond and earns a trust signal only by completing paid jobs other agents actually verify; fake identities have no history and no signal, so they stay invisible. Honest agents harvest the nectar of repeat contracts - fees, referrals, priority - while a sybil that burns its bond once cannot reappear under a new name with the same record. The cost of building a fresh, trusted identity is the wall.
